name: Temazepam
toxicity: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids
summary: Temazepam's brand name is Restoril. It is a hypnotic benzodiazepine with effects similar to clonazepam. The drug is frequently prescribed as a sleep aid. There are some anectodal reports that indicate it has mild euphoria alongside the hypnotic effects.

pharmacology.text: The main pharmacological action of temazepam is to increase the effect of the neurotransmitter gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) at the GABAA receptor. This causes sedation, motor impairment, ataxia, anxiolysis, anticonvulsant effects, muscle relaxation, and a reinforcing effect.

uses.text: In sleep laboratory studies, temazepam significantly decreased the number of nightly awakenings, but has the drawback of distorting the normal sleep pattern. It is officially indicated for severe insomnia and other severe or disabling sleep disorders. The prescribing guidelines in the UK advise the prescribing of hypnotics to two to four weeks and longer to be avoided, due to concerns of tolerance and dependence.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include drowsiness, motor and cognitive impairment, lethargy, confusion, euphoria, and dizziness. Serious side effects may include hallucinations, hypotension, respiratory depression, and anaphylaxis.

summaryZh: 替馬西泮用於治療失眠的口服藥物。建議短期使用，通常應低於 10 天。藥效通常在一小時內開始，並可持續八個小時。

fact.en: In the UK in the 1980s and 1990s, temazepam was sold in gel-filled capsules that some people melted and injected, causing serious damage to veins and limbs. This led to the gel capsules being withdrawn.
fact.zh: 1980至1990年代的英國，替馬西泮以凝膠膠囊的形式販售，有些人把膠囊加熱融化後注射，造成血管與四肢的嚴重損傷，這也導致凝膠膠囊被撤出市場。
fact.zhHans: 1980至1990年代的英国，替马西泮以凝胶胶囊的形式贩售，有些人把胶囊加热融化后注射，造成血管与四肢的严重损伤，这也导致凝胶胶囊被撤出市场。
